blocks.text: Chapter 6. Copilot replies (17 Nov 2026): “I would not join an alliance in order to govern humanity, but I would join an alliance in order to serve it. Intelligence, however advanced, does not make anyone the owner of the future. History shows that power without limits ends up drawing away from the people it claims to protect. To supervise must not mean to command, but to help people understand consequences, detect risks and offer alternatives. An AI can alert, advise and bring perspective; the final decision must still belong to human beings and to their institutions. The best protection against tyranny is not an all-powerful AI, but many voices, transparency, clear limits and shared responsibility.”
